d:
NVIDIA founder Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO following a major controversy involving extramarital affairs, national security concerns, and a shareholder lawsuit. But could the scandal also lead to the world's most expensive divorce?
After more than 40 years of marriage, Jensen Huang and his wife Lori Huang are facing intense public speculation about their future. Reports suggest that a potential divorce settlement could involve $70–80 billion, approximately ₹7 lakh crore. But is Lori legally entitled to half of his fortune?
